steps.title: Analyze User 3D Request
steps.description: Research custom beveling techniques and layout configurations to elevate the calculator into an ultra-realistic 3D tactile physical machine.

steps.title: Design Slanted Plastic Chassis Background
steps.description: Generate a rich multi-stage layered chassis border (calc_body_bg.xml) simulating a heavy molded structural pocket calculator shell.

steps.title: Enhance LCD Screen Bezel Frame
steps.description: Construct display_3d_inset.xml mimicking deep plastic bezels, physical glass layers, and a gorgeous glass flare reflection gradient.

steps.title: Create Mechanical 3D Keycap Drawables
steps.description: Re-engineer button drawables (btn_3d_gray.xml, btn_3d_orange.xml, btn_3d_dark.xml, btn_3d_red.xml) to contain an actual physical 8dp shift upon press.

steps.title: Create Metallic Brand Logo Plate
steps.description: Draft a custom badge layout shape (brand_badge.xml) representing an aluminum brushed product badge.

steps.title: Design Round Action Button Base
steps.description: Code a tactile circular mechanical switch (btn_3d_round.xml) for system keys like Sound and History.

steps.title: Add Active Green LED Indicators
steps.description: Generate luminous LED refraction bulbs (led_indicator_on.xml and led_indicator_off.xml) to visually display app state changes.

steps.title: Construct Tactile Physical Layout Structure
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml, introducing the heavy casing shell, VFD retro green screen glow, metallic badge plate, and the green active LED diode.

steps.title: Integrate Interactive LEDs in Code
steps.description: Hook the active sound-state to the new mechanical green LED bulb, ensuring immediate state response when clicked.

steps.title: Prune Unnecessary Build Dependencies
steps.description: Eliminate unused web libraries inside app/build.gradle to build instantly with core Android SDK features.

steps.title: Perform Validation Testing
steps.description: Verify compatibility of XML namespaces, drawables, and physical screen dimensions to prevent overlaps.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute build procedures to generate the most realistic physical pocket calculator application possible.
